name: unsafe-migration-backfill
title: in-migration backfill / rewriting column add (locks a live table)
detail: A bare UPDATE ... SET (data backfill) or an ADD COLUMN ... NOT NULL (table rewrite) inside a Prisma migration.sql runs in the migration's single transaction and LOCKS row ranges — on a large, 24/7 table that stalls all live traffic (an outage). Two paying-client stores are live.
fix: Zero-downtime pattern: add the column NULLABLE/no-default (metadata-only), deploy app code that fills it on every NEW write first, then backfill old rows in a background job in small batches with a between-batch DB-load check. Never one big UPDATE in the migration.
